title: FeyNoBg – Automatic background removal model and training library
claim: Show HN: FeyNoBg – Automatic background removal model and training library
why_good: An open background-removal model + training library — a proven paid category (remove.bg) with a fresh open, self-trainable angle.
value: Sell an API + a fine-tuning/hosting tier to apps and studios doing bulk image editing; per-image or subscription.
risk: remove.bg and the big image models already do this well; open weights help, but quality + throughput must compete.
